notes.title: Return to Ash - Now in Chinese!
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to share that Return to Ash now supports [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] and [b]Traditional Chinese[/b]! ✨[/p][p]Whether you’re diving into the story for the first time or returning for another run, you can now experience the game fully localized in both language options.[/p][p]Thank you to all our players for your support![/p]
